arguments.content:
#!/bin/sh
# Nightly log backup. Bundles logs/ into a tarball and copies it to the destination.
set -eu

# Backup destination: a local directory or "host:path" for remote transfer.
# Set via the BACKUP_DEST environment variable (or change the default here).
DEST="${BACKUP_DEST:?BACKUP_DEST must be set (local directory or host:path)}"

STAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d)
BUNDLE="logs-$STAMP.tar.gz"

if [ ! -d logs ]; then
    echo "error: logs/ not found; nothing to back up" >&2
    exit 1
fi

tar -czf "$BUNDLE" logs/

case "$DEST" in
    *:*)  # remote destination: host:path -> use rsync over ssh
          if command -v rsync >/dev/null 2>&1; then
              rsync -z "$BUNDLE" "$DEST/"
          else
              scp "$BUNDLE" "$DEST/"
          fi
          ;;
    *)    # local destination directory -> plain copy
          cp "$BUNDLE" "$DEST/"
          ;;
esac

echo "wrote $BUNDLE; copied to $DEST"

arguments.command: sh -n backup.sh && mkdir -p /tmp/bktest && BACKUP_DEST=/tmp/bktest ./backup.sh && ls -la /tmp/bktest/ && tar -tzf /tmp/bktest/logs-$(date +%Y%m%d).tar.gz && rm -f logs-*.tar.gz && rm -rf /tmp/bktest
